# one-pi-one-price

> One currency. One price. The Law of One Price explains why identical, freely tradable assets converge to a single market price.

## Core Principle
"A currency cannot have two prices."  
Same asset + free movement + comparability => price convergence via arbitrage.

## Key Arguments
- Law of One Price (LoOP)
- Arbitrage enforces equilibrium
- Fungibility requires price unity
- Effort vs market pricing (fairness vs mechanics)
- Native asset vs IOU distinction
- Real examples: Kimchi Premium, Gold, Cross-listed stocks

## Focus
Explains the mined-vs-bought Pi debate through economics, not blockchain tracing.
